title: stored status ordinal of the disbursed loan (detail read-back)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json (GET /working-capital-loans/1, tenant gerege): the status block of the disbursed loan. The m_wc_loan row carries loan_status_id 300 (loanStatusType.active, flag active=true) after the draw, and the read-back serialises it as status {"id":300,"code":"loanStatusType.active","active":true}. expect.detail.status_id="300" transcribes the stored ordinal the detail read-back's status.id field carries and expect.detail.status_active="true" its active flag; neither is a money cell. WHAT THIS VECTOR DISCRIMINATES: a status read-back that derives code and active flag from an enum that says ACTIVE but serialises status_id from a stored row the disburse step left stale at 200 (registered as workingcapital-wrong-status-ordinal) goes red on status_id under this vector — WC-02, which pins the code only, cannot see that drift. Both the enum code (WC-02) and the stored ordinal (WC-04) are pinned, so the two cannot silently disagree.

provenance.note: Every expect field is transcribed from the committed capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the seeded loan whose status block holds the stored ordinal.
